title: Synthetic Specimen Passport (Clean)
description: Standard biometric passport specimen with valid dates, clear resolution, and matching facial portrait.
details: All fields present, valid expiry (2032), no tampering anomalies, matching portrait photo.

title: Synthetic ID Card (Expired Date)

details: Optical quality good, but document validity has expired, prompting human review recommendation.

title: Synthetic Visa (Tamper Indicators)
description: Visa specimen exhibiting localized high-density edge anomalies and abnormal quad variance.
details: High edge gradient anomalies, noise discrepancies, triggering prototype tampering alert.

title: Synthetic Passport (Face Mismatch Test)
description: Valid passport paired with an unrelated applicant selfie to evaluate biometric correlation failure.
details: Selfie missing or mismatched facial geometry causing biometric verification divergence.
